entities.name: Gray-white smoke

entities.name: Horizontal white light strip array

entities.name: Black reflective segmented floor

entities.name: Dark background
entities.identification: The nearly black background area visible behind the smoke and light strips, excluding the floor, smoke, and lighting fixtures.
